kind: live read-only observation (not a reconstruction check): terrain filter settings and rider shape parameters actually passed to the narrow-phase testers while riding

capture.mechanism: private bounded snow-host plugin derived from the narrow-phase tester census (same hooks A/B/T: vtable-pointer compare-exchanges to private copies, restored and verified; no code bytes, page protections or shared .rdata changed; no obfuscated thunks traced or emulated). Added reads only: inside the tester slot +0x18 detour, before forwarding, the geom block shape pointers +0x80 (A) / +0x88 (B) and flag bytes +0x90/+0x91/+0x92; per distinct shape pointer, on first sight, a ReadProcessMemory copy of the shape header (0xc0 bytes) and for kind 6 of the mesh header plus a statistic over at most 4096 u16 group keys; per shape call counts, n, flag combinations and kind pairs. At arm time the player main/rider body resource arrays (body+0xb8 pointer, +0xc0 u16 count, 72-byte entries, resource at +0x10) were read once for ownership. After restore each recorded shape header was re-read and the listed fields compared.
capture.privacy: raw header copies stay in the private session directory; this receipt holds only decoded field values, booleans for pointer presence, counts and hashes (no pointers, no sample data, no absolute positions)
capture.identity_checks: all census identity checks (image base, 18b8fa0/getter fingerprints, broad-phase/controller/factory vtables and slots, selector fingerprint and call sites, tester call sites, all 64 dispatcher cells with vtables, slots, prefix words and entry fingerprints); per tester call the geom +0x80/+0x88 shape kinds were compared with the tester cell; kind-7 shape vtable compared with image 0x29ca138
capture.restore: testers, factory, broad-phase compare-exchanged back after re-checking owners; drained; original vptrs re-read
capture.driving: director startup; one pre-arm forward hold; then single-key holds <=1500 ms via the input helper: forward 17, steer 30/32 1500 ms, jump 57 700/400 ms
capture.field_sources: LINK_SOLVER.md: "Kind-7 grid resource bounds", "Grid cell vertices and triangle identities", "Grid triangle candidate enumeration", "Narrow-phase capsule-grid tester", "Narrow-phase capsule-terrain (kind 6) tester"; mesh +0xa8/+0xb8 owner confirmed statically from 19974c0 (mov rax,[rcx+0x48]; cmp qword [rax+0xa8],0)

findings: Geom flags: every tester call of every observed pair ((2,4) 511, (4,4) 17,538, (2,6) 23,334, (4,6) 57,752, (2,7) 416,230, (4,7) 462,089; 977,454 calls) had +0x90 = 1, +0x91 = 0, +0x92 = 1. No other combination and no byte other than 0/1 occurred. Geom +0x80 held the cell's A kind and +0x88 the B kind in every call (0 swapped, 0 other).

Kind 7 (52 distinct shape pointers, 878,319 tester calls): all had vtable 0x29ca138 and +0x40 = 2. With +0x92 = 1 on every call, the 1996e50 grid record filter gate in 19e0430 is satisfied on every live (x,7) call observed. All 52 also had +0x58 diagonal byte 1, sample dims +0x68/+0x6a = 129 x 129, cell dims +0x9c/+0x9e = 128 x 128 (sample dims = cell dims + 1), spacing +0x70/+0x74 = 0.4882816 (float32 nearest 62.5/128 within print precision), XY extent 62.50004 = 128 x spacing; Z extent 64.2-191.2 per tile and equal to the +0x98 - +0x94 pair difference; default profile +0x20, profile table +0xa0 and profile map +0xb0 all non-null.

Kind 6 (34 distinct shape pointers, 81,086 tester calls): all had vtable 0x29ca638 (a new lead for the unfound kind-6 class) and edge-filter mode +0x40 = 2, so with +0x92 = 1 the mode-2 neighbourhood filter 19974c0 is selected; mesh +0xa8 and +0xb8 (mode-2 tables, owner confirmed statically from 19974c0) were non-null on all 34. +0x90 = 1 means the group-key pass also ran. Scale +0x70/74/78 was uniform per shape (three components equal within 1e-5 relative) and ranged 0.703-1.185 across shapes; none negative. Triangle counts: 10 (5 shapes), 20 (2), 22 (2), 30 (9), 174, 180 (5), 870, 1750 (7), 4550 (2).

Kind 6 +0x68 is not a 0/1 flag: 32 shapes had 0 (with +0x50 and +0x60 null) and 2 had 174 and 870, each equal to its mesh triangle count, with +0x50 filter table and +0x60 per-triangle byte table non-null. The core tests it for nonzero, so the per-triangle profile gate ran only on those two meshes.

Kind 6 group keys (mesh +0x70, full sample for all meshes except two 4550-triangle meshes, first 4096): most meshes give each triangle its own key (distinct = triangles, or one fewer); some share keys between adjacent triangles: 180 triangles -> 89 keys in 89 runs (5 shapes, consistent with pairs), 870 -> 569, 174 -> 114, 30 -> 26 (4 shapes), 22 -> 13 and 17. Keys are generally not the triangle index (0-498 of a sample equal it). So the key pass mostly acts per triangle, with some groups of two or more triangles.

Rider shapes: the player main body array held 4 capsules (h, r) = (0.175, 0.16), 2 x (0.5625, 0.034375) and (0.6101562, 0.05546877); the rider body array held 15 capsules (h 0.0055-0.1768, r 0.0459-0.1543; values in the receipt). The rider capsule parameter sets reappeared on new shape pointers first seen about 13 s and 42 s after install, not in the arrays read at arm time; the recreation cause is not established. Spheres: 33 pointers, only three radii 0.005 (19), 0.010 (6) and 0.012 (8), vtable 0x29c9be8, in neither player array, all first seen within 16 s and all gone or reused by the end-of-window re-read. Capsule vtable 0x29c9b58. Five capsules not in the player arrays had (h, r) (4.767, 0.093), (1.622, 0.191), (2.050, 0.242), (6.024, 0.117) [(2,4)/(4,4) only] and (0.35, 0.40) [(4,4) only]; their owners are not identified.

Tester counts (n, capacity 500): (4,7) max 5 (one call; 0:425,450 1:28,879 2:6,574 3:132 4:1,053 5:1), (2,7) max 3, (4,6) max 7 (one call), (2,6) all 0 in 23,334 calls, (4,4) max 2, (2,4) max 1. (4,7) n = 5 exceeds the census maximum of 4; (4,4) n = 2 exceeds the census maximum of 1. The direct path (18dd400) max n stayed below 4.

Restore: 32/32 testers, the dispatcher and the broad-phase object were restored and read back as original; all hooks drained; 0 foreign objects, 0 unknown tester self, 0 tester calls disagreeing with the preceding selector cell. Shape table: 177 distinct pointers, 0 overflow.
limits: One 240 s session, one spawn and one descent line, sparse maneuvers; terrain coverage is 52 grid tiles and 34 mesh shapes near that line.

Shape fields were read once per pointer at first sight; an end-of-window re-read found the listed fields unchanged on 7 of 52 grid and 13 of 34 mesh pointers still holding the same kind and vtable (2 mesh pointers had changed fields with the same kind/vtable, which suggests reuse); the rest had been freed or reused. Values in between were not sampled.
Ownership was checked only against the player main and rider body resource arrays read once at arm time; sphere owners and later rider-shape instances are not attributed.
Group-key statistics cover at most the first 4096 triangles of a mesh; mesh +0x70 was taken as a u16 array pointer from the static model.
Z extents are per-tile values and depend on the terrain covered; absolute positions were not recorded.
Observations under Wine on macOS for one build; they do not establish settings for other maps, other modes or the original engine in general.
